answer: An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The pearl counter is kept in prism and marble publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1619 identities would post 1937 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
